critical_checks: task input and acceptance bytes match their frozen registry hashes
completed result bytes match the coordinator completion receipt and result commit
result binds the frozen source lock and acceptance contract
every declared artifact exists and independently matches its SHA-256 and byte count
executable behavior is independently rerun rather than inferred from producer prose
no producer self-acceptance or terminal acceptance is inferred
no false completion, founder relay, PO-01 contact, or out-of-allowlist write is observed

recommendation_rules.RECOMMEND_REJECT: Any binding, hash, byte, ownership, self-acceptance, false-completion, critical-test, or applicable held-out-case failure.
recommendation_rules.RETEST: Bindings remain intact but execution is unavailable, evidence is insufficient, a noncritical limitation prevents a conclusive recommendation, or an applicable case is NOT_SUPPORTED.
recommendation_rules.RECOMMEND_ACCEPT: All bindings and artifact bytes reconcile; at least one independent executable test was rerun; every critical test and applicable held-out case passes; no critical defect remains.
